name: Hemlane
positioning: Software plus a local agent and a 24/7 repair desk — for the owner who is not in the same city as the property.
description: Hemlane combines rental management software with optional human services: a local leasing agent network for showings, and 24/7 maintenance coordination that triages tenant calls and dispatches vendors. Owners choose how much of the operation to delegate.
real_estate_use: It targets the remote owner who does not want a full management company taking eight to ten percent. The software handles marketing, screening and rent; the local agent handles the showing that cannot be done remotely; the repair desk answers the two a.m. burst pipe. The economics sit deliberately between self-management and full delegation.
features: Local leasing agent network for showings
Lease tracking with state-specific compliance guidance

use_cases.job: Manage an out-of-state rental without paying full management fees
Have someone answer the emergency maintenance call at night
